inputs.name: hand over from Model Serving Endpoint to API Gateway

output.level_0: Requests fail randomly because the endpoint crashes and the gateway cannot route traffic properly.
output.level_1: No connection exists between the serving endpoint and the API gateway, so no traffic flows.
output.level_2: Engineers manually update gateway routes whenever the model serving endpoint changes its address.
output.level_3: The gateway automatically discovers and routes to the serving endpoint without human intervention.
output.level_4: Policy engines enforce strict access controls and audit logs on all gateway to endpoint traffic.
